pages.text: Thermal is the primary $(t2)Tier 2$() tech mod. Ore processing, machines, and Steel production.$(br2)$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Steel is the $(t2)T2$() baseline material. Thermal Smeltery produces Steel Ingots efficiently. The Series covers Energy, Dynamics (pipes/ducts), and Cultivation (farming machines).$(br2)$(bold)Ore processing:$() $(t2)Tier 2$() marks the start of ore doubling and tripling. A Thermal Smeltery + Pulverizer setup yields 2–3 ingots per ore.$(br2)$(bold)Material relevance:$() Signalum, Lumium, and Enderium are $(t2)Tier 2$()–$(t3)3$() Thermal alloys. Enderium is a $(t3)T3$() material in this pack.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$() Efficient Engineering passive boosts all Thermal machine speeds. A $(t2)T2$() Artificer with good Skill investment is ahead on material production.$(br2)$(bold)No book needed.$() Thermal Series is fully documented in JEI - every machine recipe, augment slot, and component is listed. The $(bold)Thermal Manual$() item provides in-game tooltips when held.
